systems.name: Google Chrome & Gemini

systems.name: YouTube
systems.activity: Tutorials, football highlights and match analysis, gaming content and AI news

systems.name: Spotify

systems.name: Pinterest
systems.activity: Browsing visual references and gathering design and art inspiration
systems.decides: Which pins fill my home feed and the 'more like this' grid under each pin

systems.name: Facebook Marketplace

systems.name: Steam
